title: Wren Simsy
summary: Wren Simsy summons assassins, with more pressure when a larger group is nearby.
overview: Wren Simsy summons assassins, with more pressure when a larger group is nearby.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for two assassins as combat starts.
The opening participant check adds an assassin for each nearby player beyond four.
Finish the encounter inside the thirty-minute appearance window.
Wren's death removes the remaining shadowed assassins.
